items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: The first one was in it... That was Dutray's brother, Noray Dutray... [INTERVIEWER] Well who are those people in the picture? There's a drummer. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Winnie Carter. Philip Nixon, Samuel Dutray, Albert Baptiste.

ctx.x: The first one was in it when you first joined. But in that Silver Leaf band, who was in it when you first joined?

The first one was in it, but the first one was just that bunch that you see in there with the exception of the trombone is not there. That was Dutray's brother, Noray Dutray. Honoré Dutray was his name. Besides that, that was the whole band. Those days we didn't use piano hardly. That's the way all those bands were. They didn't hardly use any piano.
Well who are those people in the picture? There's a drummer.
